**Coaching note (80 words max):**
Your opponent's knight on e5 was attacked twice and defended once—a classic target. When you capture it with your bishop, it's not just a trade: your new bishop on e5 forks both the d6 bishop and f6 knight. Black must recapture to avoid losing the piece, but any recapture leaves you up material or winning the c7 pawn. Look for double attacks when capturing loose pieces—it's often worth taking even if they can recapture.
